environment.description: Service deployed on same EKS cluster but fronted by an nginx ingress controller configured with mutual TLS verification. The ingress resource specifies annotation nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-tls-verify-client: 'on' with auth-tls-secret pointing to a CA bundle (corp-client-ca) that only issues certificates to registered internal service accounts via HashiCorp Vault PKI backend with role constraints (allowed_domains=[*.presence.internal], enforce_hostnames=true, client_flag=true). The ingress terminates TLS and validates the client certificate CN against an allowlist ConfigMap before proxying to the backend. Additionally, a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts ingress to the pod ONLY from the ingress controller pods (label: app.kubernetes.io/name=ingress-nginx), blocking any direct pod-to-pod communication. The WebSocket upgrade is only forwarded if the client certificate validation succeeds at the nginx layer.

config.network_policy: ingress only from pods with label app.kubernetes.io/name=ingress-nginx
